SERV.description: Serviceability Parameters (SERV). Per-key deflection limit and amplification factor for the serviceability (deflection) check. To use any /DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/* endpoint, first activate the AIJ-ASD02 design code with PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. Note: PUT overwrites BOTH fields; an omitted field is written with its default value, not preserved. DELETE removes the entry.

DEFLECT_CONTROL.description: Deflection Control limit denominator N: allowable deflection = L/N (e.g. 300 means L/300).

DAF.description: Deflection Amplification Factor multiplied onto the computed deflection before comparison with the limit.
